question: I want to update the Wix Editor to the new Wix Studio Editor.
candidate_answer:
To update from the Wix Editor to the new Wix Studio Editor, follow these steps:

- Check if your current Wix site is compatible with Wix Studio, as some features or customizations may differ.
- Backup your existing site content and data to prevent any loss during the transition.
- Access Wix Studio through your Wix account or by visiting the Wix Studio platform directly.
- Rebuild or migrate your site within Wix Studio, as it may not support direct in-place upgrades from the Wix Editor.
- Review and adjust your site's design and functionality to leverage Wix Studio's enhanced capabilities.

Note: Wix does not currently offer a direct update or automatic migration path from Wix Editor to Wix Studio; the process involves manual migration.

If you need detailed guidance, consult Wix support or official Wix Studio documentation.
gt_answer: If your site was originally created using the Wix Editor, it is not possible to migrate it to the Studio Editor. In order to take advantage of the new features and functionality, please rebuild your site in the Studio Editor.

- Use the site editor’s preview mode to test how pages render on different devices, including tablets.

On iPads and tablets Wix sites are cropped within the [vertical gridlines](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-working-with-the-editor-gridlines) of the Editor.

To resolve this issue:

question: I am trying to change the order of the items within a CMS collection on my Wix site, but the provided steps did not work for me.
candidate_answer:
To change the order of items within a CMS collection on your Wix site, please ensure the following steps:

- Go to your Wix Editor and open the CMS Collections panel.
- Select the collection you want to reorder.
- Use the "Sort" option to define the order based on a specific field (e.g., date, name, or a custom number field).
- If you want a custom order, create a numeric field (e.g., "Order") in your collection and assign values to each item reflecting the desired order.
- Sort the collection by this numeric field in ascending or descending order.
- Refresh your site to see the updated order.

If these steps did not work, verify that:

- Your dataset on the page is connected and set to use the same sorting criteria.
- You have published the site after making changes.
- There are no conflicting filters or sorts applied in the dataset settings.

If issues persist, please provide details about the steps you followed and any error messages for further assistance.
gt_answer:
To change the order of items within a CMS collection on your Wix site, you should follow these steps:

1. Go to the CMS in your site's dashboard or editor.
2. Click on the relevant collection.
3. If you have multiple collection views, select the view you want to sort items in.
4. Click 'Sort' at the top of your collection.
5. Click '+ Add a Sort'.
6. Choose the field you want to sort by from the 'Sort by' drop-down menu.
7. Select the sorting order (e.g., A-Z, Low-High, Oldest-Newest).
8. Click 'Add Sort'.
9. To apply this order to your live site, enable the 'Mirror on Site' toggle at the top of the collection.

If these steps did not work, ensure that the 'Mirror on Site' feature is enabled, as this is necessary for the order in your collection view to be reflected on your live site. Additionally, check if there are any sort conditions added to datasets, as these can override the order set in your mirrored collection view. For more detailed guidance, you can refer to the [Wix support article on mirroring item order](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-mirroring-the-order-of-items-in-your-collection-to-your-sites-connected-elements).

To customize your store layout and image display:
Click the Layout tab to select the best Product Page layout for your shop. Then, customize how images are displayed.
1. Click the Layout tab and select a layout for the Product Page.
2. Click the Stretch to full width toggle to enable it. 
3. Select how you want to display image thumbnails under Show thumbnails.
4. Click the Image ratio drop-down and select a ratio.
5. Select an option under How's image resized:
  - Crop: Crops all images to the same size.
  - Fit: Maintains the images' aspect ratios.
6. Click the Zoom on image toggle to enable it (available for some layouts). 
Note: To preview the zoom, go to your live site.

Tip: Click Reset to original layout to reset your Product Page to its original layout settings. 

Learn more about [displaying images in your store](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-setting-how-store-images-are-displayed).
